# raw/ — Original sources (do not edit)

- `papers/`: journal and conference papers. Name each file `<FirstAuthorSurname><Year>_<keyword>.pdf`
- `standards/`: codes and standards (e.g. JSCE, RILEM, Chinese JGJ/T specifications)
- `theses/`: dissertations
- `data/`: your own experimental data, if any
- `xml-archive/`: superseded Europe PMC XML copies of 20 papers, replaced by the publisher PDFs on 2026-10-21 (not used as sources)
